help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Everything you need to get started with app2nix
help.step1_desc: Click Browse to select a Linux package file (.deb, .rpm, .AppImage, .flatpak, .snap, .tar.gz, .zip) or drag and drop it.
help.step2_desc: Click Analyze to detect the package format, extract dependencies, and generate a NixOS expression automatically.
help.step3_desc: Review the generated Nix expression. You can edit it directly in the editor, then save it as default.nix or flake.nix.
help.step4_desc: Click Install on NixOS to build and install the package directly, or use the saved .nix file with nix-env or nixos-rebuild.
help.formats_desc: app2nix supports the following package formats:
help.faq1_a: app2nix converts Linux packages (.deb, .rpm, .AppImage, etc.) into NixOS expressions.
help.faq2_q: Why do I get webkitgtk_4_0 has been removed?
help.faq2_a: This means the package depends on an old WebKit version. app2nix automatically maps it to webkitgtk_4_1.
help.faq3_q: How do I install a .deb package?
help.faq3_a: Browse for the .deb file, click Analyze, review the Nix expression, and click Install.
help.faq4_a: Yes! Check System install (sudo) before clicking Install.
help.faq5_q: What if a dependency cannot be resolved?
help.faq5_a: Some uncommon libraries may not have a NixOS equivalent. You may need to search on search.nixos.org.
help.tip1_desc: If you get a sandbox error, run: sudo chmod 755 /
help.tip3_desc: After installation, app2nix installs .desktop files for your application menu.
